header.title: How to Care for Stainless Steel Appliances
header.description: This guide provides a step-by-step approach to cleaning and maintaining the appearance of stainless steel appliances, covering everything from basic washing to removing stubborn marks.

steps.description: Read the manufacturer's instruction manual before cleaning stainless steel products to understand specific cleaning instructions and approved products.
actions: Take out the manufacturer’s instruction manual
Read through the guide
Ensure you are aware of any specific instructions
Identify approved cleaning products
Identify products that should not be used

steps.description: Wash the appliance's surface with a warm, wet cloth, following the grain of the steel and rinsing thoroughly.
actions: Fill your kitchen sink with warm water
Immerse a cleaning cloth
Squeeze out any excess liquid
Use the warm wet cloth to remove any dirt or residue from the surface of the appliance
Rub the cloth over the surface following the grain of the steel
Add a drop of gentle liquid detergent to your water (if needed)
Rinse any detergent off the surface with clear warm water

steps.description: Wipe the appliance surface with a lint-free towel to remove water residue and prevent mineral deposits.
actions: Use a lint-free towel
Wipe the appliance surface
Remove any water residue
Prevent mineral deposits

steps.description: Polish the appliance's steel surface with vinegar or baking soda to brighten its shine.
actions: Pour a small amount of vinegar into a bowl.
Dip a clean cloth into the vinegar.
Polish the steel in the direction of the steel grain.
Rinse the vinegar off with warm water.
Sprinkle baking soda onto a clean sponge.
Rub the steel gently with the sponge.
Rinse the area thoroughly with warm water.

steps.description: Remove stubborn marks and stains from the stainless steel appliance using appropriate cleaning products and techniques.
actions: Spray a small amount of glass cleaner onto a lint-free cloth.
Polish the surface in the direction of the steel grain to rub out marks.
Continue rubbing until the surface is shiny and all of the glass cleaner has been buffed off.
Use stainless steel cleaner to reduce staining and scratching and increase shine, following manufacturer's directions.
Wait until the appliance is cool.
Rub club soda onto heat stains with a cloth, following the grain direction.
